shortDescription: "Attack of the Clones Speeds Up CVS Strategy," at 9:40 a.m. ET on Sept. 15, misattributed quotes from two CVS Health executives. Quotes attributed to Tilak Mandadi were spoken by Sri Narasimhan, and quotes attributed to Narasimhan were spoken by Mandadi.
